messages:
hana-fin: Customer Meridian filed a dispute for 2026-06-11 — they say ~510k embeds were billed twice during a short ingest window. They attached SDK logs and their invoice redline. Can eng/data confirm so we can decide on a provisional credit?

omar-eng: please drop org_id and a couple sample request_ids, I'll run a quick distinct vs raw count.

sasha-cs: org_id=meridian-enterprise. CSV uploaded to secure share and sent to @omar-eng. Customer asks for provisional credit while we investigate.

pietro-data: quick scan on embed_events for meridian-enterprise, region=apac, window 2026-06-11T03:20-03:50Z: raw_rows=1,012,344 distinct(request_id, ack_id)=502,031 -> estimated duplicates ~= 510,313. Query used GROUP BY request_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1.

omar-eng: checked apac-ingress-proxy logs. There's an unusual pattern where the proxy returned 524 (timeout) to clients but actually committed the write to the backend before timing out, then the SDK retried. Snippet: 

```
[2026-06-11T03:27:10Z] apac-ingress-4 upstream_status=524 request_id=mm-201 attempt=1 ack=true
[2026-06-11T03:27:11Z] apac-ingress-4 upstream_status=200 request_id=mm-201 attempt=2 ack=true
```

omar-eng: ingest pipeline currently persists event on initial receipt and runs dedupe during downstream compaction. So duplicates persisted. Root cause looks like proxy timeouts with backend commits.

deploy-bot: apac-ingress-4 alert: elevated upstream 524 between 2026-06-11T03:25 and 03:35 UTC. queued_requests_peak=45,678.

hana-fin: propose provisional credit $561 (510,313 * $0.0011 = $561.34). Approve provisional to prevent escalation?

pietro-data: we can run a dedupe+replay to produce canonical distinct counts. Caveat: there is a tiny risk that an SDK retry where the first attempt actually failed would be dropped; logs suggest most first attempts succeeded server-side. ETA for full recount+replay ~5h.

sasha-cs: customer wants immediate provisional. I'll send a message if we issue.

billing-bot: Created provisional credit ticket FIN-3222 for $561 for meridian-enterprise period=2026-06-11 reason="ingress-proxy timeout committed then retried -> duplicate embeds" status=pending-approval.

hana-fin: I approve provisional credit. Please mark provisional and follow-up with final reconciliation outcome.

pietro-data: starting full dedupe job now; will post final distinct counts and reconciliation CSV when complete.

hana-fin: thanks team. Keep thread updated. We'll true-up next invoice depending on results. :handshake:
